"'''Little Noti'''"<ref name="SubtitleID">{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> was the alias of a member of the [[Noti]] [[species]] that resided on [[Peridea]] alongside a nomadic village of their people. After the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] became stranded on Peridea, the Noti became acquainted with him, and acquired a pendant bearing the [[Rebel Alliance starbird|Rebel Alliance Starbird]]. Little Noti later encountered [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] during the [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search for Ezra]] and, after calming down from being discovered, showed her their pendant and led her to their village—and thus Bridger.<ref name="PartSix" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Little Noti appeared in "[[Part Six: Far, Far Away]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', which was released on [[September 19]], [[2023]].<ref name="PartSix" /> Their name was not revealed in the episode, however the episode's captions have identified the character as Little Noti.<ref name="SubtitleID" />
